import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

s = "1704660000"
unit = "s"
origin = "unix"

res_str = pd.to_datetime([s], unit=unit, origin=origin)
res_int = pd.to_datetime([int(s)], unit=unit, origin=origin)

out = {
  "res_str": str(res_str),
  "res_int": str(res_int),
  "equal": bool((res_str == res_int).all()),
}

out["res_str_i8"] = res_str.view('i8').tolist()
out["res_int_i8"] = res_int.view('i8').tolist()

probe(out)
